observations.classification: Related 059 connected source question; bounded current trace, no unconditional new defect.
observations.trace: The caller requires physical data but accepts optional item properties and topology. Runtime-item classification checks the catalog; presentation copies item text and uses topology placement text or default "worn". For a fitted-to-owner item the separately inspected fit-selection path admits the item/placement pair against the current catalog. For an unworn display it reuses a prior fit if available or selects the first authored placement, so it does not always consume the default.
observations.conditions_and_limits: If a real fitted-to-owner item has no topology or placement ID and its catalog item has no "worn" placement, selected fit admission can fail. The sources read do not establish that such a state is produced by a supported live path, nor that optional topology is invalid for held or dropped display. The missing-topology question remains open rather than a confirmed user-facing failure.

observations.classification: Source-backed bounded nonfinding; preserve intentional interval distinctions.
observations.trace: The two f32 helpers convert the high 24 bits and divide by 2^24 or 2^24−1; f64 uses the high 53 bits and 2^53 or 2^53−1. Those finite integers and positive denominators represent the documented [0,1) and [0,1] endpoint distinctions. Seed adapters consume existing seed bits without a draw; stream adapters call next_u64 once.
observations.conditions_and_limits: This is static arithmetic reasoning, not an RNG draw, numerical experiment or proof of input distribution, cross-target replay, stream namespace uniqueness or downstream range operations. Original 774 RIG-ADMISSION03-REGISTER-033 and witness-003 cover P16 1–35, while historical pr-working role2248 and prior 95e evidence had their own full 1–58 views.

observations.future_direction: Preserve distinct half-open/inclusive endpoints and one-draw behavior if future numeric ownership changes are made; any wider sampling or replay assurance needs its own supported consumer evidence.

observations.classification: Existing prior 059 q662 conditional, no new duplicate.
observations.trace: The separately inspected stream adapter checks finite ordered endpoints then computes min + unit*(max−min) in f32. Existing ASSESSMENT-DETERMINISM-95E.json discusses opposite-sign extreme finite endpoints whose mathematical span overflows f32; these are outside the unit-helper admission contract itself.
observations.conditions_and_limits: Actual RNG draw, reachable application caller and feature/runtime behavior not established here. Do not confuse the range operation with the correctness of the high-bit unit conversion; no execution, tests or simulated inputs.

nonfindings: The original runtime-fitted predicate checks catalog membership before marking presentation, so arbitrary unknown item names are not admitted by this selected predicate alone. This does not establish complete producer validation.
Optional topology and display while unworn are explicit shapes in current source; do not label every fallback as invalid without actual lifecycle and catalog evidence.
is_preparing is specifically pending-task state, not proof that all assets, equipment, scene and GPU work are ready.
The powers of two and mantissa bit widths describe numeric conversion, not arbitrary gameplay tuning constants; f32/f64 and inclusive/half-open endpoints are distinct.
Nothing in this packet executes RNG, tests, assets, renderer, GPU, fitting or product; the displayed role2594 test source is text only.

lens_perspectives.assessment: Item/placement IDs and fallback worn pass a catalogue boundary; retained raw names and error strings need consumer/owner policy, not blanket rejection.
24/53 high-bit widths and 2^n or 2^n−1 are representation-owned conversion constants; cache counter and numerical ranges remain separate concerns.
Catalogue selection belongs to its existing typed owner; seed and deterministic stream owners are distinct from presentation identities.
LayerSelection resolves canonical CatalogItem/CatalogPlacement and typed Seed maps to numeric helpers. Earlier identity remains raw until the shown admission.
Half-open and inclusive intervals, stored seed versus consuming a stream draw, task pending versus global readiness, and body/design versus per-fit failure remain distinct.
Endpoint scaling is source-reasoned; separately observed range_f32 subtraction can overflow under previously qualified extreme inputs, not a unit-helper failure.
Cache body/design/failed/pending/model state has related invariants but actual reset, retry and item ownership remain open.
Catalog runtime-item predicate and fit pair admission form distinct gates; arbitrary missing topology in a supported owner path is unproven.
Pending/failed/cache option structures expose distinguishable modes; no enum rewrite is justified solely by a boolean.
Raw presentation item/placement identities and canonical catalog selection coexist at a transition; actual divergence and authority policy remain open.
Exact assigned P16 and 95e per-file bytes agree. Preserve unworn first-placement and previous-fit modes and inclusive endpoint; equality is not runtime validation.
Trace properties/topology into presentation and separately into fit admission; seed/stream adapters reach the four interval helpers. Other producer/consumer routes remain open.
Current cache includes task/asset/native resource state; no proved harmless derive or serialization simplification in selected source.
